text:
Alex: Heads-up — plan to deprecate config.flag_enable_legacy_routing next week. Need a safe traffic-shift playbook.
Priya: +1. Are we replacing with routing.policy_v2? What's the migration path?
Alex: Yes. Plan: 1) Canary 1% traffic -> v2 (shadow writes) 2) 5% 3) 25% 4) 100%. Telemetry gating at each step. Rollback if error rate > 0.5% or latency p95 increases > 30% for 15m.
Sam (oncall): Who runs the canary? Can we automate via console? 
Jenna: We should add a "deprecation" badge in console and a 'migrate' button that can schedule shifts.
Mateo: Agree. Also need audit events and a dashboard tile: requests_by_variant, error_rate, p95_latency, kv_cache_hit.
Alex: Draft of rollout command:
```
redwoodctl routes shift --config routing.policy_v2 --cohort canary --percent 1 --monitoring-hook /playbooks/monitor-depr
```
Priya: love the CLI. Add --auto-rollback and a cool-off window param.
Alex: Proposed gating rules:
- duration: 30m per step
- error_rate_threshold: 0.5%
- p95_latency_threshold: +30% vs baseline
- anomaly_alert: if request volume drop > 20%
If any trigger hit, rollback to previous variant and notify #eng-oncall
Sam (oncall): Make sure ops-bot posts runbook link and has a 'pause/abort' button.
Mateo: Also add segment-level targeting: we should start with internal segments + low-risk customers.
Jenna: UX: console should surface 'expected cost delta' for new routing because v2 might use different model sizes.
Alex: Telemetry: capture per-flag cohort, route_variant, model_id, tokens_per_request. Need trace id propagation.
Priya: Quick question: do we keep legacy flag around for 30 days after full shift? Legal wants 90 days for audit.
Jenna: Product suggests 60 days. Let's make it configurable per-deprecation with defaults.
Sam (oncall): Ops checklist before start: pre-rollout smoke test, canary infra quota check, alert rule sanity, runbook link, owner assigned.
Alex: I'll own the playbook. @Priya can you add the console button work? @Mateo add telemetry dashboard panels? @Sam sign off on alerts?
Priya: Yup, will add console PR tomorrow.
Mateo: I'll draft dashboard and add synthetic traffic script.
Sam (oncall): Will validate alerts and set escalation policy. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: scheduled: deprecation-rollout-6212345678 created by Alex for 2026-04-12 02:00 UTC. See /playbooks/deprecate-v1
Alex: Final note: include a dry-run option that does shadow routing without real traffic changes. We'll run that two days before.
Jenna: Nice. Can we add a telemetry baseline job to compute p95/p50 baseline automatically? 
Mateo: Yes — will run baseline collector and commit to metrics bucket.
Alex: OK, moving forward. Starting doc updates and PRs. Thanks all. :rocket:
